title: Find Rice Walket

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: Ah, yah finally found me. Knew this was bound to happen.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah, yah finally found me. Knew this was bound to happen.

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: Look, let's just get the gab over with and figure out what's about to happen.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, let's just get the gab over with and figure out what's about to happen.

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: Sorry, Comms speak. It's ingrained despite the fact that she's lost me so many Lims.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry, Comms speak. It's ingrained despite the fact that she's lost me so many Lims.

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: Seas below... Mizzy can look for the broad side of a HOVA while standing on an active railway.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Seas below... Mizzy can look for the broad side of a HOVA while standing on an active railway.

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: Did. Until 'Sec shut 'em down and blamed 'technical difficulties'. HA! It's technically difficult to keep all her lies straight.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did. Until 'Sec shut 'em down and blamed 'technical difficulties'. HA! It's technically difficult to keep all her lies straight.

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: You're really here on behalf of that Crusty Punk-wannabe-gambling-dipshit? She screwed me over worse than a bootleg relay installed in a headset. You ever see someone with a Comms scar on the side of their face? Mizzy left one on my brain.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're really here on behalf of that Crusty Punk-wannabe-gambling-dipshit? She screwed me over worse than a bootleg relay installed in a headset. You ever see someone with a Comms scar on the side of their face? Mizzy left one on my brain.

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: Funny. Mizzy should stop gambling and become a writer cuz that's better than half the shit you see on the Nets.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Funny. Mizzy should stop gambling and become a writer cuz that's better than half the shit you see on the Nets.

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: I'm assuming you met Mizzy in a cafe in Metro Hub, right? Little corner chair like she's some slick gangster with a favorite seat that always belongs to them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm assuming you met Mizzy in a cafe in Metro Hub, right? Little corner chair like she's some slick gangster with a favorite seat that always belongs to them?

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: And then she wrangled you in with promises on how to read the boards, yeah? Told you to come back a few days later and she'd show you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And then she wrangled you in with promises on how to read the boards, yeah? Told you to come back a few days later and she'd show you?

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: It is, but not one of mine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It is, but not one of mine.

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: Ha. Grifters gonna grift. That's Mizzy's whole schtick. Lures you in with the promise of easy Lims and the allure of that board and its glowing letters and numbers. Should be illegal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha. Grifters gonna grift. That's Mizzy's whole schtick. Lures you in with the promise of easy Lims and the allure of that board and its glowing letters and numbers. Should be illegal.

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: Listen, I owe Mizzy a thousand Lims. I know that. But that shit owes me so much more than that. She cost me my job. My livelihood. My PASSION. She cost me the blasted Comms!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Listen, I owe Mizzy a thousand Lims. I know that. But that shit owes me so much more than that. She cost me my job. My livelihood. My PASSION. She cost me the blasted Comms!

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: Gambling on the boards! Then people like Mizzy would have to find another way to swindle hard workin' folks like you and me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gambling on the boards! Then people like Mizzy would have to find another way to swindle hard workin' folks like you and me.

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: CorpSec discovered the back channels I had open for Mizzy to talk directly to the conductors. She won't say it, but that was the acid on the body of the Comms. Final thing 'Sec needed to shut 'em down.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: CorpSec discovered the back channels I had open for Mizzy to talk directly to the conductors. She won't say it, but that was the acid on the body of the Comms. Final thing 'Sec needed to shut 'em down.

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: I setup a voice network for an entrepreneur. I had no idea what she was doing with it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I setup a voice network for an entrepreneur. I had no idea what she was doing with it.

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: Regardless... I didn't realize what she was doing until I lost that bet. The delay was perfectly timed and then all of a sudden it was off. I couldn't believe it. Fucking heart sank faster than a decommissioned satellite.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Regardless... I didn't realize what she was doing until I lost that bet. The delay was perfectly timed and then all of a sudden it was off. I couldn't believe it. Fucking heart sank faster than a decommissioned satellite.

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: A 200-1 payout. I lost it all and she ordered de-oiled oysters from her beloved little shop.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A 200-1 payout. I lost it all and she ordered de-oiled oysters from her beloved little shop.

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: When I found out, I swiped what Lims I could from Mizzy and booked it. I knew she'd send someone after me eventually but I didn't care.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When I found out, I swiped what Lims I could from Mizzy and booked it. I knew she'd send someone after me eventually but I didn't care.

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: A chat log.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A chat log.

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: I had a bot transcribe the backdoor channel's I connected and now have an entire text log of Mizzy and the conductor. CorpSec would be pretty interested in what they talked about.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I had a bot transcribe the backdoor channel's I connected and now have an entire text log of Mizzy and the conductor. CorpSec would be pretty interested in what they talked about.

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: That was only the first part. Then they talked about doing it again. And again. They were gonna pad their accounts and sift the Lims through their false businesses.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That was only the first part. Then they talked about doing it again. And again. They were gonna pad their accounts and sift the Lims through their false businesses.

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: But she didn't get the other channels, the ones I had hidden and bootlegged across different waves.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But she didn't get the other channels, the ones I had hidden and bootlegged across different waves.

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: No, but you are. Be on the right side of history here. Let's screw the ones who screw people like us.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, but you are. Be on the right side of history here. Let's screw the ones who screw people like us.

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: Let me guess... Mizzy told you she'd help you learn the boards, make some Lims, and pad those pockets, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let me guess... Mizzy told you she'd help you learn the boards, make some Lims, and pad those pockets, right?

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: Okay... humor me then. Why are you attempting to wrangle up Mizzy's debts? She got something on you or are you just bored?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Okay... humor me then. Why are you attempting to wrangle up Mizzy's debts? She got something on you or are you just bored?

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: Right on. Here, take this. It's a bootleg Nata-Log. The chat is transcribed alongside the route data. Even the idiots at CorpSec should be able to see this corruption.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right on. Here, take this. It's a bootleg Nata-Log. The chat is transcribed alongside the route data. Even the idiots at CorpSec should be able to see this corruption.

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: Yeah, so did you listen to the story I just told you? This is what Mizzy does. Don't fall for it. Work with me to bury this fucker.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, so did you listen to the story I just told you? This is what Mizzy does. Don't fall for it. Work with me to bury this fucker.

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: Right! Then here's a reason to sway to my side: Mizzy ain't gonna teach yah anything. She's gonna bring you into the fold and bleed yah dry. What do you say?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right! Then here's a reason to sway to my side: Mizzy ain't gonna teach yah anything. She's gonna bring you into the fold and bleed yah dry. What do you say?

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: Get it to 'Sec. They'll take the info from it and make their move.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Get it to 'Sec. They'll take the info from it and make their move.

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: Because technically I'm involved. Sure I could use this to try and convince them to clear my case, but that still leaves me hanging on the backdoor channel charges. Potential charges.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because technically I'm involved. Sure I could use this to try and convince them to clear my case, but that still leaves me hanging on the backdoor channel charges. Potential charges.

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: Should be as hands off as possible. I'd use the Drop Box Terminal down in the Industrial District.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Should be as hands off as possible. I'd use the Drop Box Terminal down in the Industrial District.

nodes.speaker: Rice Walket
nodes.text: Ha! As if she has the money to buy you off. Come on, don't get wishy-washy on me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha! As if she has the money to buy you off. Come on, don't get wishy-washy on me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You must be Rice?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You must be Rice?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why would people be looking for you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why would people be looking for you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why would people be looking for you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why would people be looking for you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Mizzy's looking for the money you owe her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mizzy's looking for the money you owe her.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Mizzy's looking for the money you owe her.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Mizzy's looking for the money you owe her.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sorry?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sorry?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you have her money or not?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you have her money or not?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you have her money or not?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you have her money or not?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not a fan?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not a fan?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You work with the Comms?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You work with the Comms?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So... I take it you don't have Mizzy's Lims?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So... I take it you don't have Mizzy's Lims?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So... I take it you don't have Mizzy's Lims?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So... I take it you don't have Mizzy's Lims?

nodes.text: She said you got a delay bet wrong and skipped out on paying.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She said you got a delay bet wrong and skipped out on paying.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: She said you got a delay bet wrong and skipped out on paying.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: She said you got a delay bet wrong and skipped out on paying.

nodes.text: How'd you guess?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How'd you guess?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is this a trick?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is this a trick?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't have time for this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't have time for this.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't have time for this.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't have time for this.

nodes.text: So?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Explain.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Explain.

nodes.text: What should be?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What should be?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can you get to the point, please?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can you get to the point, please?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Can you get to the point, please?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Can you get to the point, please?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Still doesn't straighten out today.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Still doesn't straighten out today.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you helped Mizzy fix her bets?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you helped Mizzy fix her bets?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So you helped Mizzy fix her bets?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So you helped Mizzy fix her bets?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fair. It isn't the supplier's responsibility what the buyer does.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fair. It isn't the supplier's responsibility what the buyer does.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Fair. It isn't the supplier's responsibility what the buyer does.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Fair. It isn't the supplier's responsibility what the buyer does.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I mean... It was both of you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean... It was both of you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I mean... It was both of you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I mean... It was both of you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She bet against you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She bet against you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's your plan?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's your plan?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Be more specific.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Be more specific.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: CorpSec is really going to care about some board reading?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: CorpSec is really going to care about some board reading?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: CorpSec is really going to care about some board reading?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: CorpSec is really going to care about some board reading?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're gonna turn it over to them?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're gonna turn it over to them?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're gonna turn it over to them?

nodes.text: Mizzy was using those channels when I met them though.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mizzy was using those channels when I met them though.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Mizzy was using those channels when I met them though.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Mizzy was using those channels when I met them though.

nodes.text: I'm down.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm down.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Definitely not.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Definitely not.

nodes.text: She did.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She did.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not interested in that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not interested in that.

nodes.speaker: Player

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Reason doesn't matter.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do I do with it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do I do with it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do I do with it?

pronounText.TextSheVersion: I could sell it to Mizzy.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I could sell it to Mizzy.
